messages.content: Create at most two reusable medical-image reading skills from this training example. The saved answer/reason may be wrong. Return only JSON {"skills":[{"category":"general or one supplied official category","trigger":"when to apply","steps":["concrete image check","how to distinguish alternatives"]}]}. No case/patient ID, option letter, figure number, patient-specific number, copied question, or rule merely repeating the reference diagnosis. General medical findings are allowed. Skills will only be used on other patients. An empty skills list is allowed.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings, what is the most likely explanation for the patient's sudden clinical worsening 18 days after admission? Consider the changes between the initial and follow-up X-rays and the clinical history provided.

A) Progressive COVID-19 pneumonia leading to ARDS
B) Development of a right pleural effusion
C) Worsening of right lung opacities indicating bacterial superinfection
D) Onset of a right pneumothorax not detected by X-ray
E) Pulmonary embolism with no evidence in X-ray
F) Normal evolution of COVID-19 pneumonia
